lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing shadows on the bedroom wall
Waiting for the heavy rain to fall
Counting heartbeats in the hollow night
Chasing ghosts of every fading light
[Pre-Chorus]
The weight of silence starts to grow
Finding seeds of truth beneath the snow
[Chorus]
Break the chains of the inner cage
Turn the page of a hidden age
Rising higher like a mountain peak
Finding the words I was afraid to speak
[Verse]
Dusty paths and roads left far behind
Searching for the peace I had to find
Every whisper turns into a steady roar
I am not the person I was before
[Pre-Chorus]
The horizon calls my name out loud
Rising like a sun above the cloud
[Chorus]
Break the chains of the inner cage
Turn the page of a hidden age
Rising higher like a mountain peak
Finding the words I was afraid to speak
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
No more running from the inner tide
Nowhere left for my soul to hide
[Chorus]
Break the chains of the inner cage
Turn the page of a hidden age
Rising higher like a mountain peak
Finding the words I was afraid to speak
[Outro]
